main_text.p: locus. Cum frustra remedium De Ufi-bus feu-dor.l,2. tit.27. in med. Ini-tii. Bald. in l. cum fi-lius.final, D.de leg. 2.in defectum probationum ad-hiberi solitum, admittatur, si abunde de facto constet, neque ex formula Doctorum certio-ratus judex, amplius oportet certiorari. Paulo tamen gene-ralius hoc loco de duello agere decrevi, quam ut vulgari pro-bationi tantum applicari de-beat.

Bocer. de duell, c.1.Bocerus tum demum locum obtinere censet duellum, cum pugna duorum, nec legitimâ de causâ est inchoata, nec auctoritate ducis aut Imperatoris exercitus inita. Verùm meo judicio minus accurate. Neque enim tot gentium domitor Alexander Magnus ideo duellista (utar illâ voce) appellandus, quod cum plerisque gentibus bellum gesserit, eo non ritè in antecessum, per specialem indicto. page.notes: Right top corner mark and bottom right faint marks are show-through or digitiser marks, not transcribed. The printed long-s ligatures ("st") in "frustra", "minùs", "infestum" are rendered as plain s per the rules. "defectum" and "specialem" are read from ligatured letters in the scan and may be imperfect. The bottom-right "ma-" is treated as the catchword.
